title: Calculate a weighted Day yield 2
scenario: An invented finishing team records independent production batches. Batch sizes differ, and the requested population is Day batches only. All records and limits are fictitious training assumptions.

lesson.intro: A pooled yield divides selected good units by the same population of inspected units. SUMPRODUCT can multiply a Boolean selection mask by an aligned quantity column. A mean of batch percentages gives each batch equal weight and answers a different question.

formulas.name: SUMPRODUCT
formulas.explanation: Aligned arrays are multiplied entry by entry and their products are summed. Additional arrays are optional; double unary converts TRUE/FALSE to 1/0.

formulas.name: ROUND
formulas.explanation: Round the final ratio to the requested precision.

task.prompt: Calculate 100 × total Good_units / total Inspected_units for Day batches only. Use the identical Day population in both totals, retaining every repeated shift record and legitimate zero-volume batch. All quantities are numeric, without blanks; the selected inspected total is positive. Round the final percentage number to two decimals (for example 93.25, not 0.9325). Return one numeric value in Answers!B2. Use an Excel formula; any equivalent approach is accepted. Submit the formula and the complete output.

columns.name: Inspected_units
columns.description: Numeric nonnegative units; zero is a zero-volume batch.

columns.name: Good_units
columns.description: Numeric units, between zero and Inspected_units.
